name: Omapasskey
author: Divanyx
description: Passkeys for Omarchy the way Windows Hello and macOS do them: Firefox, Chromium and every FIDO2 app store passkeys on this machine, in the TPM chip. Keys never leave the TPM, every use needs your PIN plus both Shift keys pressed on a real keyboard, so no program or AI agent can sign in for you. A themed prompt shows which site is asking.

barWidget.description: Shows whether the TPM passkey service is ready and lights up while a site waits for your confirmation. Click to set it up or to see its status.

schema.label: Show the icon in the bar
schema.description: The confirmation prompt still appears when the icon is hidden.

schema.label: Where the confirmation prompt appears
schema.description: The prompt shows on the focused monitor and never takes keyboard focus; the browser keeps it.

schema.label: Note every passkey use
schema.description: Shows a short note after each sign-in or registration, so every use leaves a visible trace.
